page.layout: One column of running text, full width. No marginal notes. Below the last line, at the right, the catchword "Hambur-". Above the text, the page number and running head.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: fvorum hæreditate locuples ac potens, ut est natura hominum, à magnis ad majora contendebat, & jus, quod multorum erat, in se solum sensim trahebat, seque summum prætorem per totam illam oram haberi volebat: atque hanc ad rem amicitia Hamburgensium, & Ailconis Houwerdæi, & affinitate Grethanorum, qui tum in Frisia Orientali supra reliquos in Nobilitate eminebant, quorum erat gener & sororius, abutebatur. Hinc fa-ctiones vicinorum contra ipsum, & inimicitiæ mutuæ, interdum & injuriæ: & ipse Eppo turbidior Groninganis, & societati eorum infestus, ac vicissim civitatis animi non satis in eum placati: videbanturque ad arma res tendere, cùm inter Hamburgenses & Groninganos in-ducia biennes sunt factæ. His induciis durantibus pactiones illæ, de quibus dixi, anno cccc.xxxv cum civitate initæ. At induciis vixdum finitis incrudescere prio-ra, Ailco & Eppo in cives aut socios Groninganos injurii esse, & vicissim à Groninganis pati, quæ nollent: Eppo præcipuè, qui parte opum est ejectus

page.notes: The running head reads "Frif." in the header; the long s may be intended as "Frisf." or "Fris.", so it is marked as doubtful and kept as printed. The first word "fvorum" is printed "fuorum" and was changed to consonantal v per the u/v rule. "vixdum" and "vicissim" were read from the printed forms "viciffim" and "vixdum". The hyphenated line-end words "fa-ctiones", "in-ducia" and "prio-ra" keep their printed hyphens. No marginal notes are printed on this page. The digitiser's watermark at the lower right is excluded.
